common_name: Winter's Rose Camellia (Cold-Hardy Small Pink Formal Double Ackerman Camellia)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in fall or early spring in moist, well-drained, acidic, humus-rich soil in partial shade; Winter's Rose is part of Dr. William Ackerman's Winter series of cold-hardy camellias bred for fall-into-winter bloom.

directions: Plant in moist, well-drained, acidic, humus-rich soil in partial shade, and mulch to protect the shallow root system through winter cold. Winter's Rose belongs to the Ackerman-bred Winter series of cold-hardy camellia hybrids, notable for its small, formal double, soft pink blooms and unusually dense, compact growth habit compared to other Winter series cultivars, making it well suited to foundation plantings or containers. It flowers over a long season from fall into early winter when few other shrubs are blooming. Feed lightly with an acid-forming fertilizer after the main bloom period, and prune only to shape immediately after flowering ends, since next year's buds set on the current year's new growth.

directions: Plant in well-drained, acidic, humus-rich soil in full sun to partial shade.
